en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Ali Bin Al Nu’man, from Suweyd Al Qalla’a, from Abu Ayoub, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘For Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic there are two (types of) Knowledges – a Knowledge which no one knows except Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and a Knowledge which He<sup>azwj</sup> Taught His<sup>azwj</sup> Angels, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasools<sup>as</sup>. So whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> Taught His<sup>azwj</sup> Angels and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasools<sup>as</sup>, so we<sup>asws</sup> know it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabber from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from Suwayd al-Qalla from abu Ayyub from abu Basir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has two kinds of knowledge. One kind of knowledge is that which no one knows except He. The other kind is that which He has taught to the His angels and His messengers. Whatever His angels and Messengers have learned we know it.”
